descricao: E3.50: laço de espera do log da skill esperar-estado, com o caminho literal, passa mesmo com .forge/ no caminho.

tool_input.command: for i in $(seq 1 5); do grep -q '^rc=' /root/.forge-contrib/run/.forge/envio.log 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 30; done; echo "fim=$(grep -m 1 '^rc=' /root/.forge-contrib/run/.forge/envio.log 2>/dev/null || echo teto)"; test -f /root/.forge-contrib/run/.forge/envio.log && grep -q '^rc=' /root/.forge-contrib/run/.forge/envio.log
